Summary
Adds a Vendor_OpenMenu hook for Ratchet & Clank 1 (NTSC-U and PAL v2.00), allowing mods to intercept vendor menu opening, including the Gadgetron PDA remote vendor.
Motivation
The Archipelago mod can remove all purchasable vendor items. Opening the Gadgetron PDA with no available menu rows can cause a crash.
Existing vendor interaction hooks can handle physical vendors but do not intercept the PDA's remote menu opening.

pullRequests.title: fix(hostgen): pass over an assembly signature once the function has C
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/hostgen-stale-asm-signature
pullRequests.body: Building rac2-ntsc from a decomp newer than the port stopped hostgen: assembly signature for func_L04_00411298: expected an assembly-only function. The decomp had matched that function since its signature entry was written. hostgen now warns and leaves the function to its C. A signature for a host-defined function, or for one the program doesn't have, is still an error. There's a test for the new case.

pullRequests.title: fix(rac2): the race HUD wrappers take the game function's result type
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/rac2-race-hud-result
pullRequests.body: hud.c's RACE_HUD defined every race HUD wrapper as void. rac2-decomp's matched func_L04_00411298 returns s32, so building against the newer decomp failed with conflicting types. The wrapper now takes the game function's own result type and restores the HUD in a cleanup after the call. It still compiles where the function is assembly-only (void).

pullRequests.title: perf: copy an effect texture once a frame, not once a quad
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: fix/effect-quad-fps-drop
pullRequests.body:
Before: in some camera spots the game draws ~1000 effect quads (Blarg Station by the ship: 264 quads, then 1186 after a small camera move). Each quad copied its texture and CLUT (~5 KB) again, and the renderer copied and hashed each one again: 12.6 MB a frame. On a phone the game tick went from 2.5 to 7.3 ms and the frame rate fell from 120 to 60.
After: the texture is copied once a frame. Same spot in the container: game tick 4.6 -> 1.9 ms, effects draw 2.9 -> 1.2 ms (Vulkan on lavapipe), the…

That is a copy of func_L00_0024BAE8 that the JP catalogue lists as boot:0020A448, and the JP decomp's C matches there (map.tsv). read_places dropped every boot: place, so the port had no function at that address. The call did nothing (call to code address 0x0020a448, which no function of the port has) and mode_freeze_state stayed at 0xB.

pullRequests.body:
Adds optional lossless storage compression for baked GI grids and reflection captures. Builds configured with OPENRAC_BAKE_LZ4=ON can use --lz4-assets when running --bake-all. Assets retain their filenames and GPU payloads, and enabled readers accept both plain files and checksummed LZ4 frames.
Compression uses the existing worker pool with bounded parallel file sizes and atomic publication. Reflection validation reuses the GI bytes already decoded by the background loader. Cache identities…

commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
Some camera spots make the game draw a field of ~1000 effect quads
(Blarg Station by the ship: 264 quads, then 1186 after a small camera
move). Each quad copied its 8-bit texture and CLUT (~5 KB) into a new
upload, and the renderer copied and hashed every one again, because
the quads take turns with two textures at one block. That was 12.6 MB
a frame: the game tick went from 2.5 to 7.3 ms on a phone and the
frames between ticks were lost (120 -> 60 fps).
